method: Observed browser interactions; manual checklist, not an automated assertion count

checks.name: Public chat streams real local model output
Exactly one assistant message per submitted question
Thumbs down updates the same vote and saved state
Stop response cancels an active stream
User A sees owned metrics and cancellation
Timeframe selection and Refresh update the period
Sign-out clears the prior chat state
User B signs in with an empty chat
User B dashboard excludes User A requests
Unknown token usage and cache rate display Unavailable
Post-fix dashboard shows cancelled error category and outcome

scope: Full browser flow before bf8b833; corrected cancellation category and dashboard checked again on bf8b833 production build. User signed out afterward.
screenshot_scope: Owner/period aggregates include setup requests and differ from the bounded HTTP-run count.
